aliases: Major objectives of the quality assurance framework
banglaExplanation: QA framework নিশ্চিত করে training institute সঠিক quality criteria ও standards মানছে।
এতে সব trainees ন্যায্য (fair) আচরণ পায়, আর একই রকম ক্ষেত্রে একই রকম assessment হয়।
Qualification-এর portability বাড়ে, ফলে international recognition পাওয়া সহজ হয়।
NTVQF courses চালাতে হলে TVET institutions-কে quality standards মানতেই হবে।

example.bn: মান বজায় রাখলে ঢাকার polytechnic-এর certificate বিদেশের employer-ও বিশ্বাস করে।
example.en: A polytechnic in Dhaka follows quality standards. Its certificate is then trusted by employers abroad.

short.modelAnswer:
The quality assurance framework offers mechanisms to establish quality criteria and standards. Its major objectives are:
1. Assuring clients and organizations that training institutes follow quality criteria and standards.
2. Ensuring fair and equitable treatment of all clients or trainees.
3. Improving the portability of qualification and facilitating international recognition.
4. Promoting the consistent application of fair and credible assessment standards.

realQuestions.answer:
The major objectives of the quality assurance framework are:
•
Assuring clients and organizations that use credential assessments (e.g.,
employers, professional regulatory bodies, immigration officers, and post-
secondary institutions) that Alliance members follow quality criteria and
standards.
•
Ensuring fair and equitable treatment of all clients of Alliance member
services.
•
Improving the portability of credential assessments and facilitating the
recognition of quality services across the country.
•
Promoting the consistent application of fair and credible assessment
standards.
